fy_label_note: December fiscal year; Baba FY labels equal calendar years. Window: last five fiscal years FY2021 to FY2025 (actuals) plus FY2026 consensus. Peak FY2024 25.05%, trough FY2026E 20.12% (company Q3 2026 guide 20% to 22%). Portfolio changes: VA consolidated EBITDA from FY2024 on excludes glass reinforcements (Composites, now discontinued; FY2024 total 2,468 = Roofing 1,532 + Insulation 945 + Doors 232 + Corporate -241) while FY2021 to FY2023 still include Composites; Doors (Masonite, closed 2024-05-15) is in FY2024 for about 7.5 months and in FY2025 onward for a full year. Organic view = Roofing plus Insulation segment EBITDA over their segment revenue (VA company data; revenue backed out of segment EBITDA and segment margin), before corporate cost: 28.95% FY2024 to 25.45% FY2026E (-350 bps) on segment revenue -4.7%. Doors segment margin 16.02% FY2024 to 9.11% FY2026E. LTM = Q2 2025 to Q1 2026 (VA has not loaded Q2 2026).

peers.peer_note: Format [FY2024 %, FY2026E %, decline bps]. Roofing and insulation (CSL, ROCKB, KRX, SGOB), doors and residential repair and remodel (FBIN, MAS). Sensitivity: the three closest end-market peers (CSL commercial roofing, ROCKB insulation, FBIN doors) have a median decline of 233.8 bps, which gives an organic ratio of 0.667. ROCKB FY2025 (12.11%) is an outlier year inside the window and does not affect the FY2024 and FY2026E endpoints.

deciding_facts: Against the six-peer set the ratio is below 0.4 on both bases: consolidated 0.24 (peer median -120 bps vs OC -493 bps) and organic Roofing plus Insulation 0.34 (-350 bps), and OC's premium to the peer median shrank from +496 to +87 bps.

The consolidated decline is about 143 bps larger than the organic one (493 vs 350 bps), and the main difference is Doors, whose margin fell from 16.0% to 9.1% after the Masonite deal. That is the same team's capital allocation, not the cycle. Borderline: the organic core fell on falling revenue (-4.7%, volume and storms, which matches management's account), and against the three closest end-market peers (CSL, ROCKB, FBIN) the organic ratio is 0.67, which would read as mixed.
